targets.summary: The shared GEMM reduction helpers (statically_known*, GemmReductionGeometry, GemmReductionExpression, GemmReductionConfig, GemmReductionPlan, etc.) were moved out to gemm_epilogue_ir; move them back, because shared code belongs in gemm_epilogue.py.
targets.evidence: In the reviewed version, gemm_epilogue.py imported the shared helpers from the separate module: `from torch._inductor.kernel.gemm_epilogue_ir import GemmReductionDescriptor`. The merged diff deletes that import. It defines the shared classes in gemm_epilogue.py again: `class GemmReductionGeometry`, `class GemmReductionDescriptor`, `class GemmReductionConfig` and `class GemmReductionPlan`, with GemmReductionArguments after them. So the shared reduction types were moved back into gemm_epilogue.py, as the maintainer asked. One thing doesn't fully match: the `statically_known*` helpers are not in gemm_epilogue.py. The file imports them from `.gemm_epilogue_utils` (`from .gemm_epilogue_utils import statically_known_shape_equal`), probably because the utils module is a common shared home for them. The main request, moving the shared GEMM reduction classes out of gemm_epilogue_ir and back into this file, is applied.
